deadline.value: Apply by 11:59pm PST, December 1, 2026 for Autumn 2027; decisions in late February 2027.
deadline.quote: December 1, 2026 is the application deadline for Autumn 2027-2028.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for EE.

gre_general.quote: The GRE exam is not required.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by a committee, not individual faculty, so no advisor agreement is needed.
supervisor.quote: Admissions decisions are made by the Admissions Committee, not by individual faculty members.

funding.value: All PhD students making satisfactory progress get full financial support for the whole program.
funding.quote: All PhD students who maintain satisfactory academic progress receive full financial support for the duration of the doctoral program.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required; apply to the PhD straight from a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: No; the minimum degree requirement is a bachelor’s degree.

also.quote: A master's degree is not required prior to applying to the PhD program in Electrical Engineering.

notes: All EE PhD applicants may request an application fee waiver (subject to review).
